pages.text: Metalworking and mining work a little differently in this world. Metal, or rather scrap metal, can be obtained from underground pipes at the beginning, while having a flimsy pickaxe, then it can be extracted from most furniture with a better pickaxe. I couldnt find the stone I needed in this world, so I replaced it with concrete. As a result, I got a concrete stove made of concrete bricks, I will write down the recipes for both.
With fuel, a concrete furnace, and scrap metal, you can get molten metal that can already be used with acid.
